s23-permit-travel-agents: Lets people in the travel-agents group make calls (attended or unattended) to tools in the booking app.
s04-payments-finance-only: Lets people in the finance group make attended calls to tools in the payments app when the token has the payments:write scope.
s04-analysts-search-ticketing: Lets people in the analysts group make attended calls to tools in the search or ticketing app.
s01-hold-large-fare: Holds unattended calls to the book_fare tool when an amount is given and the amount is over 1000, until Priya approves. It stops applying once someone has approved the call.
s23-forbid-over-cap: Blocks calls (attended or unattended) to the book_fare tool when an amount is given and the amount is over 10000.
s05-rugpull-pin: Blocks any call to any tool when the tool's description or schema has changed since it was approved.
